whitelistEnableDesc.message: When enabled, only sites and pages on the whitelist are enhanced.

description.message: Real-time video super-resolution browser extension based on Anime4K.

deleteModeConfirm.message: Are you sure you want to delete mode "$modeName$"?

crossOriginCompatModeDesc.message: Enable this if video enhancement fails on certain websites. This mode attempts to fix cross-origin loading issues. Note: For changes to take effect on open tabs, you must refresh them.

crossOriginHint.message: Enhancement failed due to cross-origin restrictions. Please enable Compatibility Mode in the options.

extensionDescription.message: Real-time video super-resolution browser extension based on Anime4K.

themeModeDesc.message: Choose your preferred theme. Auto mode follows your system preference.

restorePolicyBadgeTitle.message: Restore pass — may be affected by the restore policy.

restorePolicyDesc.message: Controls which restore passes the chain keeps. "Off" runs the full chain (full enhancement); "Gate" keeps every restore and adapts it to local contrast; "Trailing" skips restores after the final Downscale; "Leading" skips restores before the first upscaler.

restorePolicyTrailing.message: Trailing — Skip restores after final Downscale

restorePolicyLeading.message: Leading — Skip restores before first upscaler

restorePolicyNoteGate.message: Restore passes run adaptively: faint low-contrast detail bypasses them; strong edges are enhanced.

restorePolicyNoteTrailing.message: Restore passes after the final Downscale may be skipped.

restorePolicyNoteLeading.message: Restore passes before the first upscaler may be skipped.

modeDescA.message: For most 1080p anime, older 720p, and blurry or heavily compressed SD.

modeDescB.message: For most 720p and 1080p→720p downscales with ringing or aliasing.

modeDescC.message: For clean, undegraded sources: digital art, wallpapers, and 1080p→480p downscales.

modeDescAA.message: For the same sources as Mode A, with extra detail. Doubled modes are meant for 2× or higher; at lower targets they can oversharpen, so a single mode is recommended.

modeDescBB.message: For the same sources as Mode B, with extra detail. Doubled modes are meant for 2× or higher; at lower targets they can oversharpen, so a single mode is recommended.

modeDescCA.message: For clean C-class sources that look too soft. Doubled modes are meant for 2× or higher; at lower targets they can oversharpen, so a single mode is recommended.

confirmApplyTier.message: Test complete! Recommended tier: $tier$. Apply this tier?

welcomeDesc.message: Let's optimize your settings for the best experience.

gpuTestDesc.message: We'll run a quick test to determine the best settings for your hardware.

resultDesc.message: This tier is recommended based on your hardware.

manuallySelected.message: You have selected a different tier.

changeTier.message: You can also choose a different tier:

setupCompleteDesc.message: You're all set! Click the extension icon on any video page to enable super-resolution.

tip1.message: Click the purple Enhance button on videos to toggle enhancement

tip2.message: Use the popup to change modes and resolution

tipPin.message: 📌 Pin the extension icon to your toolbar for quick access

colorGradingDesc.message: Adjust exposure, brightness, contrast, gamma, saturation, and vibrance. Applied after all enhancement effects.

enableColorGradingDesc.message: When enabled, color grading is applied as the final step after all enhancement effects.

exposureDesc.message: Controls the overall light level. Measured in EV stops.

brightnessDesc.message: Adjusts the overall lightness or darkness of the image.

contrastDesc.message: Controls the difference between light and dark areas.

gammaDesc.message: Adjusts midtone brightness. Higher values brighten, lower values darken.

saturationDesc.message: Controls the intensity of all colors uniformly.

vibranceDesc.message: Selectively boosts less-saturated colors while preserving already vivid ones.

unsupportedDesc.message: Your browser doesn't support WebGPU, which is required for video enhancement.

unsupportedFirefoxNote.message: Firefox users: Enable "dom.webgpu.enabled" in about:config and restart the browser.

toggleEnhancementDesc.message: Toggle video enhancement on the active video

autoEnableOnWhitelistDesc.message: Automatically enhance videos on whitelisted sites without clicking the Enhance button.

autoEnableSettleMsDesc.message: Milliseconds to wait before auto-enabling a video, so transient players are skipped. Set to 0 to disable the delay.

showDiagnosticsDesc.message: Display a performance overlay with FPS, frame time, and GPU info during enhancement.

enableHotkeyDesc.message: Enable the keyboard hotkey to toggle video enhancement on the active video.
